Still running: the tool is on test 15 of 22, checking flashing (3.A). I'll keep waiting.

I ran the Trusted Tester checks on https://www.nasa.gov/careers/. One criterion failed, and most of the others need a person to check them. These are agent-assisted findings, not a certified Trusted Tester result.

- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions: FAIL.** The "Search" text field is labelled only by gray placeholder text, which disappears when someone types. Six more text boxes could not be judged: "Science and Research", "Data, IT, and Cyber", "Engineering", "Business Services", "Internships" and "Aspiring Astronauts". A person should look at them.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order: PASS.** Focus follows the reading order, forward and backward. The footer link columns are read column by column, so the places where focus jumps back up are between independent columns. I judged this from the numbered screenshot and the element list.
- **1.4.2 Audio Control: DNA.** No audio played on its own for more than 3 seconds in a 6.5-second watch.
- **3.3.4 Error Prevention: DNA.** The only forms are a search form and a "Was this page helpful?" form, and neither is a payment, legal or saved-data form.
- **2.4.1, 3.2.3, 3.2.4 and 2.4.5: NEEDS_REVIEW.** These compare pages of the site, and you gave me only this one page. Running them again with other pages of the site would settle them.
- **2.1.1, 2.1.2 and 3.2.1: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The keyboard did not reach every control inside the "Internships", "NASA Force" and "Veterans and Military Spouses" sections, plus two more. A person needs to check what those sections hold. The keyboard test itself could not be finished.
- **2.2.2: NEEDS_REVIEW.** One of the 39 images could not be checked for animation, and the check for content that keeps changing by itself could not be finished.
- **2.3.1: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The same unchecked image leaves the flashing check unfinished.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The tool could not finish this check.
- **1.3.1, 2.4.6 and 4.1.2 (form field labels and names): NEEDS_REVIEW.** The tool could not finish these. It could not tell whether 6 of the 7 form fields have a visible label.
- **3.2.2, 3.3.1 and 3.3.3: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The keyboard reached only 1 of the 7 form fields, so 6 were not tested.
